propositions: Every typed configuration key emitted through _SECTION_CLASSES must have a concise public_description metadata field that explains its user-visible effect or operational consequence.
The gen_config_reference.py generator must fail when any emitted field lacks nonempty description metadata and render a Description column in the generated configuration reference.
The public_description field must be co-located with each dataclass field so generator introspection remains the single source of truth and cannot drift from a sidecar registry.

Module-size constraints require extracting configuration verification logic from _config_schema.py (target: 800 lines) while preserving all typed field annotations, defaults, factories, coercion behavior, and runtime behavior unchanged.

Every generated Description cell must state a user-visible effect or operational consequence distinct from its row's Type, Default, or Lifecycle values; must be row-by-row manually reviewed and attested with reviewer identity and UTC timestamp.
